s: Dine bet hakkisse biqriat shema ubo h' seipim: keshem sheasur liqrot qeriat shema keneged hatztzoa min hattora — kak asur liqrot keneged bet hakkisse yashan, dehaynu shennishtammesh bo kebar paam echad baasiyyat tzerakayv, vaapillu im pinna mimmennu hatztzoa achar kak, shekkevan shechal alayv shem bet hakkisse paam echad — maus hu veen zeh machaneh qadosh, veasur min hattora. Vaapillu hu mimmechitztzot gebohot y' tepachim, shehen cholaqot reshut leatzman lekol mah shebbetokan, venimtza shehatztzoa shebbetokan hi birshut bipne atzmo, mikkol maqom hammechitztzot atzman kevan shehem meyuchadim lekak hem meusin kemo gerap shel rei, vetzarik leharchiq mehem d' ammot ulepanayv kimlo enayv apillu pinnu mimmennu hatztzoa. Velaken tzarik lizzaher shello liqrot o lehitpallel o leharher bedibre tora bechatzer keneged bet hakkisse kimlo enayv ap al pi shehu sagur vei epshar lirot hatztzoa shebbo. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheasa bachatzero cheder meyuchad lazeh abal im asa bet hakkisse bimchitztzot shel bayit o chatzer — en al hammechitztzot ellu din bet hakkisse ap al pi shehen gam ken mechitztzot shel bet hakkisse, (v)kevan sheenan meyuchadot lo bilbad. [U]muttar liqrot apillu besamuk lahen mammash (raq shello yihyeh samuk lehechalal shebbenehem shennipla sham velo kenegdo melo enayv):

Hizmin maqom o cheder lebet hakkisse vaadayin lo nishtammesh bo — asur liqrot betoko middibre soperim, hoil veniqra alayv shem bet hakkisse — yesh bo bizzayon laqqeria shebbetoko. Abal muttar liqrot kenegdo apillu besamuk lo tok d' ammot, sheen qeriat hashshem bilbad keday leesor chutza lo:

Hayu lepanayv b' chadarim veamar "cheder zeh yihyeh lebet hakkisse vegam zeh" — hare shenehem asurim liqrot betokam. Abal im amar al hashsheni "vecheder zeh" velo amar "vegam zeh" — hare hashsheni sapeq im hizmino lekak im lo. Lepikak en qorin lekattechilla, veim qara — yatza. Abal im qara bemaqom sheasur liqrot bevadday, apillu en issuro ella middibre soperim — tzarik lachazor veliqrot, kemo shennitbaer besiman a"a:

Bet hakkisse shehu bachapira upiv berichuq d' ammot min haggumma vehu asuy bemidron, beinyan shehari mitgalgel venopel miyyad lemerachoq, veken hamme raglayim yoredin miyyad laggumma — hare hu kesatum ukeillu en sham bet hakkisse kelal chutz laggumma (ben sheyyesh lo mechitztzot ben sheen lo), umuttar liqrot sham im en sam reach ra vegam en mashtinim chutz laggumma. Abal im mashtinim sham lipamim (uregilim bekak) — asur leharher sham bedibre tora veen tzarik lomar liqrot qeriat shema (vaapillu beshaa sheen sham me raglayim), lepi sheyyesh shem bet hakkisse al maqom zeh shechutz laggumma shemmashtinim sham, vetzarik leharchiq mimmaqom zeh d' ammot ulepanayv kimlo enayv (umikkol maqom im yesh lo mechitztzot — en lahem din mechitztzot bet hakkisse leharchiq mehen, kevan sheen hammechitztzot ella lebet hakkisse shel hatalat me raglayim, sheen asurin ella middibre soperim achar shennapelu laaretz, shehatztzoa shebbaggumma kesatum dami veen mechitztzot ellu niqraim bishbilah mechitztzot bet hakkisse):

Bene adam sheyyesh lahem sapsal naqub shennipnim alayv, veken beotam battim sheyyesh betokam kisot qetannim nequbim letzorek hayladim qetannim shebbabbayit — tzarik lizzaher sheyyihyu mekussim bishat qeriat shema utepilla vedibre tora, o yotziem mehacheder shemmitpalel o lomed bo, apillu hem neqiyyim betokam veal gabbam, shekkevan shehem meyuchadim lippanot alehem — hare hem kebet hakkisse, sheapillu en bo tzoa tzarik leharchiq mimmennu d' ammot ulepanayv kimlo enayv min hattora:
